name: Rohit Sharma
subject: Cloud Computing
info: A quick summary of core AWS services, IAM, EC2 and S3 for beginners.
content:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud computing platform, with over 240 fully featured services from data centres globally.

It pioneered the on-demand, pay-as-you-go cloud model, so businesses and developers can use compute power, storage and databases without maintaining physical infrastructure.

Key services: IAM (access control), EC2 (virtual servers), S3 (object storage), VPC (private networks).

name: Sneha Patil
subject: Computer Science
info: Simple explanation of Git commands with real world examples.
content:
Git is a version control system that tracks changes in your code.

Start with git init, stage files with git add, save a snapshot with git commit, and share work with git push and git pull.

name: Vivek
subject: Projects
info: Expense tracker built with the MERN stack and deployed on AWS.
content:
A full stack expense tracker using MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js.

The React frontend talks to an Express API, which stores expenses in MongoDB. The app is deployed on AWS.

name: Pooja Singh
subject: DevOps / Linux
info: Useful Linux commands with examples for quick revision.
content:
The most useful Linux commands for beginners: ls, cd, pwd, mkdir, rm, cp, mv and chmod.

Practise them in a terminal to remember them.

name: Aaryan Deshmukh
subject: Computer Science
info: Variables, loops, functions and lists explained with simple examples.
content:
Python is a beginner friendly language with clean syntax.

Core ideas: variables, data types, if/else, for and while loops, functions and lists. Practise by writing small programs every day.

name: Kartik Raj
topic: Data Structures: Arrays and Linked Lists
subject: Computer Science
info: How arrays and linked lists store data, and when to use each one.
content:
An array stores items in continuous memory, so reading by index is fast but inserting in the middle is slow.

A linked list stores nodes that point to the next node, so inserting is fast but reading by position is slow.

name: Kartik Raj
subject: MCA
info: Formulas, examples and important points for MCA.
content:
Topics covered: matrices, determinants, rank, eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

Remember: det(AB) = det(A) x det(B), and a matrix is invertible only when its determinant is not zero.

name: Sneha Patil
subject: MCA
info: Most expected and repeated questions with answers for university exams.
content:
Frequently asked: ER diagrams, normalization (1NF to BCNF), ACID properties, joins, transactions and indexing.

Write one clear example for each topic in the exam.

name: Aditya Kulkarni
subject: BCA
info: Processes, threads, scheduling and memory management in simple words.
content:
A process is a running program. A thread is a smaller unit of work inside a process.

CPU scheduling decides which process runs next (FCFS, SJF, Round Robin). Paging splits memory into fixed size blocks.

name: Pooja Singh
subject: BCA
info: OSI model, TCP/IP, IP addressing and common protocols.
content:
The OSI model has 7 layers: physical, data link, network, transport, session, presentation and application.

TCP is reliable and ordered. UDP is faster but has no delivery guarantee.

name: Kartik Raj
subject: DevOps / Linux
info: Images, containers and the basic Docker commands you need first.
content:
Docker packages an app and everything it needs into a container.

Basic commands: docker build, docker run, docker ps, docker stop and docker compose up.

name: Rohit Sharma
subject: DevOps / Linux
info: Pods, deployments, services and the kubectl commands to remember.
content:
A pod is the smallest unit in Kubernetes. A deployment keeps the right number of pods running. A service gives pods a stable address.

Useful: kubectl get pods, kubectl apply -f, kubectl logs and kubectl describe.

name: Aaryan Deshmukh
subject: Cloud Computing
info: How buckets, objects and permissions work in S3 and IAM.
content:
S3 stores files as objects inside buckets. Buckets are private by default.

IAM controls who can do what, using users, roles and policies. Always give the minimum permissions needed.

name: Pooja Singh
subject: Cloud Computing
info: Core Azure services and how they compare with AWS.
content:
Azure Virtual Machines are like EC2. Blob Storage is like S3. Azure Active Directory handles identity.

Learn the shared responsibility model and the pricing basics first.

name: Vivek
subject: Computer Science
info: useState, useEffect and useRef with small working examples.
content:
useState keeps a value that changes. useEffect runs code after the page renders. useRef keeps a value without re-rendering.

Rule: only call hooks at the top of a function component, never inside loops or conditions.

name: Aditya Kulkarni
subject: Projects
info: A simple Java project with classes, file handling and a menu.
content:
Features: add books, issue and return books, search by title and track due dates.

Built with Java OOP: Book, Member and Library classes, with data saved in a text file.

name: Sneha Patil
subject: Study Material
info: A 3 month plan for aptitude, coding and interviews.
content:
Month 1: aptitude and DSA basics. Month 2: coding practice and core subjects (OS, DBMS, CN). Month 3: mock interviews and resume.

Practise a little every day instead of cramming.

name: Rohit Sharma
subject: Study Material
info: Percentage, profit and loss, time and work, and speed formulas.
content:
Percentage change = (change / original) x 100.

Profit % = (profit / cost price) x 100. Speed = distance / time. Work done = rate x time.

name: Aaryan Deshmukh
subject: Other
info: What to write, what to skip and how to keep it to one page.
content:
Keep it to one page. Lead with projects and skills. Use clear numbers, like how many users or how much faster.

Skip photos and long objective statements. Save it as a PDF.

name: Vivek
subject: Projects
info: Build a simple REST API with Express and MongoDB.
content:
Create routes for GET, POST, PUT and DELETE. Use Mongoose to define a schema and save documents.

Test each route with Postman before connecting the React frontend.

name: Sneha Patil
subject: BCA
info: Classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism and encapsulation.
content:
A class is a blueprint and an object is one copy made from it.

Inheritance reuses code, polymorphism lets one method behave in different ways, and encapsulation hides data behind methods.

name: Kartik Raj
subject: MCA
info: Waterfall, Agile, Spiral and V-model compared.
content:
Waterfall moves step by step and is hard to change. Agile works in short sprints with regular feedback.

Spiral adds risk analysis to each loop, and the V-model pairs every build stage with a test stage.

name: Pooja Singh
subject: Other
info: Simple habits to balance classes, study and rest.
content:
Plan the next day each evening. Study in 25 minute blocks with short breaks.

Put the hardest subject first, and keep one fixed rest hour every day.
